metadata.numeric_boundary: Python arbitrary precision, explicitly checked i128 intermediates and i64 final totals, manual/source amounts. Contributor residuals are decimal TEXT. Not a Rust execution.
metadata.data: synthetic only; temporary SQLite databases below storage/ removed at exit
metadata.exit_policy: Nonzero only for runner failures. Unsupported operations and design limitations are observations.

schema_from_sqlite.name: commands_no_delete
schema_from_sqlite.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER commands_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON commands
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER commands_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON commands
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append only'); END

bound_integer_insert.message: Python int too large to convert to SQLite INTEGER

encoding_boundary.implication: A residual INTEGER row cannot encode MIN-1. Decimal TEXT requires exact application arithmetic; SQLite SUM coerces this example to REAL.

interval_policy.schema: CREATE TABLE intervals(metric TEXT, source TEXT, day TEXT, start INTEGER, end INTEGER)
interval_policy.limitation: Separate interval sketch, not an interval codec in the three integer models.

issues: aggregate_ledger cannot independently set or persist a manual contribution without extra state
legacy residuals accepted by existing arithmetic can exceed an i64 contributor row
mixed baselines require reconciliation, not automatic full source backfill
recommendation: Use typed contributor rows, an explicitly unknown legacy_adjustment, and an exact wide residual codec. Keep command receipts separate; full command history is not required by these observations.
